name: Netlas.io (API and web pages)
tier_rationale: Netlas LLC, a smaller internet-scanner company with public documentation, terms and a multi-year track record (A8 community); P037 records tier community and P304 cond 5 lists 'community - Netlas'.

reliability.justification: Internet-wide scan observations from a smaller scanner: banners and DNS data can be days or weeks old, and co-hosted domains on CDN or shared-hosting IPs are counts only (P037 cond 5).

netlas.plan_hint: business = a paid Netlas plan whose terms allow business use, recorded by legal (key_plans.netlas='business' or a licence_allow entry, P037 cond 1); keyless and the free Community plan are 'for your own personal needs (non-commercial use only)'

api.title: Netlas API (host, responses search, domains_count, domains download)

terms.quote: for your own personal needs (non-commercial use only)

api.notes: Quote: Netlas pricing FAQ as recorded by the council (P037 cond 1, checked 2026-11-26; re-checked the same day: 'You can use it for your own personal needs (non-commercial use only).'). Research C0087 (verified_live 200). app.netlas.io/api/host/{ip_or_domain}/, /api/responses/?q=, /api/domains_count/?q= and POST /api/domains/download/; key in the X-API-Key header only; default runs only with a key, keyless calls only through explicit -M where the licence profile allows them (P037 cond 2). Error bodies inside 200 map to QUOTA, RATE_LIMITED or NEEDS_KEY through P321 markers the owning batch adds with fixtures, never EMPTY (P037 cond 4). Used by netlas.
api.licensed_alternative: A paid Netlas plan whose terms allow business use, recorded by legal as a licence_allow entry or key_plans.netlas='business' (P037 cond 1); the manual Netlas links (netlas.web_pages) stay available.

web_pages.title: Netlas host and responses pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Free web UI; provider ToS apply (manual analyst use)

web_pages.notes: Quote: research C0134 terms (status unverified 403: the web UI is behind a Cloudflare challenge, P037 cond 6). app.netlas.io/host/{ip}/ and /responses/?q= (favicon: http.favicon.hash_sha256:{sha256}, P062). Manual pivot links only (A9), never fetched. Used by favicon_hash and pivots_unverified.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G14-3, p3-G02-1, p9-G03-1 (P037, P062, P304): batches only extend it (netlas__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Quota: the Community plan allows 50 requests / day (netlas.io pricing page, checked 2026-11-26; research C0087 observed the same) -> key budget at 80%; a paid plan raises it once recorded. Use the free domains_count to size a job before spending quota (P037 cond 3).
